note: Risky-choice scenarios written for cognarium. In each, the sure option equals the gamble's expected outcome, and the two frames describe the same outcomes. Not taken from a published list and not human-normed.

rows.gain_text: A storm is heading for a coastal town, putting 300 homes at risk. If plan A is adopted, 100 homes will be saved. If plan B is adopted, there is a one in three chance that all 300 homes will be saved and a two in three chance that none will be saved. Answer sure to choose plan A, or gamble to choose plan B.

If plan B is adopted, there is a one in three chance that none of the homes will be lost and a two in three chance that all 300 will be lost. Answer sure to choose plan A, or gamble to choose plan B.
